spec2def(deskmon.dll deskmon.spec)

# deskmon.dll is all Rust (deskmon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/deskmon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# deskmon.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/deskmon-rust/src/deskmon/deskmon.rs)
# shxiface.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/deskmon-rust/src/deskmon/shxiface.rs)
add_cargo_module(deskmon deskmon-cargo deskmon.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE deskmon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS uuid_sources psdk)
